# Bella Casa Co.

> Bella Casa Co. is a Melbourne bathroom renovation company. It designs and builds luxury bathrooms and ensuites on one fixed price and a dated schedule, with one point of contact from quote to handover.

Indicative starting price for a bathroom renovation: $27,500 including GST ($25,000 + GST). This is a base: the final price depends on the size of the room, the layout and the finishes, and a fixed price is confirmed after a site assessment. A bathroom renovation can take anywhere from 2 to 3 weeks, depending on how big the renovation is. Service areas: Northern, Eastern, Southern and Western Melbourne. Phone: 0451 671 500. To request a quote, use the contact page.
